The chosen mileage is a designer-declared service scenario. The mechanical fatigue assessment remains at five million counted stress cycles; it does not establish component life. Payback also requires the manufactured gear to retain sufficient fatigue capacity. These examples are a defined climate comparison, not a complete certified product LCA.
